notes:
I couldn't write these notes, because the research tools stopped working before I could open a single source.

**What went wrong:** My first attempt ran about ten searches at once. That hit the tool's usage limit before any results came back. When I retried with one search for the Enduring Word commentary on Haggai 2, the system told me I had no tool calls left for this turn. So I have no pages from enduringword.com, biblehub.com, studylight.org, preceptaustin.org or any other approved site.

**Why I haven't written them anyway:** You asked me to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for every point, and not to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Notes written without reading the sources would break all three rules.

**Next step:** Ask me again in a new message and I'll search one or two sources at a time to stay under the limit. I'll start with the commentary pages that go verse by verse: Enduring Word, the Bible Hub entries for Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary, and Precept Austin. Then I'll look up the verses where readings differ most:
- **v. 7:** whether "the desire of all nations" means the nations' treasures or the Messiah.
- **v. 9:** how the later temple's glory could be greater than Solomon's.
- **vv. 6 and 21:** the "shaking," which Hebrews 12 applies to the end times.
- **vv. 12–14:** what the questions about holiness and defilement are meant to teach.
- **v. 23:** the signet ring, and whether Zerubbabel points to the Messiah.

I'll also check NET Bible notes, New Advent and catholic.com for the other views, using only what those sites actually say.
